verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented integration that links Raygun errors to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear, and no two-way status sync. The GitHub integration shown is a repository connection for source-code and source-map context, not issue tracking. Error statuses are changed manually in Raygun, and the Slack and PagerDuty items are notification or incident integrations, so they are adjacent features rather than ticket sync.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link an error to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear with two-way status sync, so fixing the ticket resolves the error and a regression reopens it
